brands.hero.title: Our brands
brands.mercedes.desc: German quality and innovation in every detail. Mercedes‑Benz is a symbol of luxury and cutting‑edge technology in the automotive industry.
brands.bmw.desc: The joy of driving and a sporty character. BMW is synonymous with dynamics, innovation, and iconic Bavarian style.
brands.mercedes.history: Since 1886, Mercedes‑Benz has been creating vehicles that shape the future — from the first patented car to modern electric models.
brands.mercedes.philosophy: "Das Beste oder nichts" — the best or nothing. Every Mercedes‑Benz embodies a pursuit of perfection in design, technology, and comfort.
brands.bmw.history: Founded in 1916, BMW started with aircraft engines. Today the company is known for sporty sedans and innovative technologies.
brands.bmw.philosophy: BMW’s philosophy is to build vehicles that deliver driving pleasure and reflect Bavarian quality traditions.
